demo.accountsDesc: Use these accounts to explore the full hackathon demo flow
demo.walkthroughDesc: Follow these steps to demo the full marketplace flow in ~5 minutes
demo.step1: Log in as buyer@nammasandhai.demo → browse Marketplace → open Krishnagiri Tomato listing
demo.step3: Log in as farmer@nammasandhai.demo → Purchase Requests → Accept the request
demo.step4: Farmer Orders → Confirm → Mark In Transit → Mark Completed
demo.step5: Check Farmer Dashboard & Sales Records (CSV export)
demo.step6: Log in as admin@nammasandhai.demo → verify users and view platform stats
